text:
```yaml
name: Java GSDK Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'java/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up JDK 8
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '8'
        distribution: 'temurin'
        
    - name: Build and test
      run: |
        cd java
        ./gradlew build
        ./gradlew :gameserverSDK:test
        
    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: java/gameserverSDK/build/reports/tests/
```
